text:
maya: Quick design question — for the compact audit changefeed export, do we attach rollout_id to every event by default? trying to keep per-tenant bundles small while preserving traceability.

samir: I'd include rollout_id but as a short stable id (8-12 chars). also add actor_hint (pseudonym) instead of full email. PII mode should strip or hash.

elaine: +1 on pseudonyming. main worry is size growth when we include diffs for large config blobs. can we server-side compute a tiny diff and only include anchors + a short diff snippet?

ben: proposed compact NDJSON example to discuss:
```
{"ts":"2026-03-18T14:22:01Z", "rollout_id":"r_8c3f9b", "actor_hint":"alice.team", "op":"update", "path":"/routing/policies/123", "diff_snippet":["- match: old", "+ match: new"]}
{"ts":"2026-03-18T14:22:02Z", "rollout_id":"r_8c3f9b", "actor_hint":"alice.team", "op":"tag", "path":"/routing/policies/123/tags", "tag":"canary"}
```
Keep full payloads behind the signed download link to save bundle size.

jess: Telemetry needs: exported_events_total, compacted_bytes_total, export_latency_ms (p50/p95), per-tenant exported_events and a marker for exports run with include_rollout_context=true.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: rollout/compact-audit-export v1 -> staging at 2026-03-18T15:00Z :rocket:

maya: UX idea — console preview streams first ~2KB of NDJSON with highlight for changed paths and a "download full bundle" button that generates signed URL. show a small provenance header: manifest with retention, hash, creation_ts.

samir: perf note — adding rollout_id as string adds ~12% size; we can compress more by encoding rollout_id as base62 8 chars. hashing actor identifiers reduces PII risk. also include a manifest field `redaction_mode` for consumers.

elaine: Export retention modes: keep_full (for internal egress), redacted (for external auditors), ephemeral_signed_url (TTL 24h). Need to align SLA for generation: target < 3s for preview, background bundle job for full export.

ben: API thought: /v1/audit/export?tenant=...&include_rollout_context=true&redaction=redacted|full. default should be redacted for external tenants. also add ?preview=true which streams first N lines.

jess: I'll wire the metrics and a small console panel showing export cost estimate (bytes -> tokens cost model) so customers see impact.

maya: action items: samir proto for hashed rollout_id + actor_hint redaction; ben server diff compute + preview stream; jess telemetry and cost panel; elaine docs for retention/SLA modes. I'll draft a short ADR and UI mock tomorrow.

samir: noted, will open PR with example serializer.

jess: will add a dashboard skeleton and alert on export_latency > 10s.

maya: thanks all — will ping again when ADR is up. :thumbsup:
